import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        // Initialize answer array
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; i++) {
            ans[i][1] = 0;
            ans[i][2] = 1;
            ans[i][3] = 0;
            ans[i][4] = 1;
            ans[i][5] = 0;
            ans[i][6] = 1;
            ans[i][7] = 0;
            ans[i][8] = 1;
            ans[i][9] = 0;
            ans[i][10] = 1;
            ans[i][11] = 0;
            ans[i][12] = 1;
            ans[i][13] = 0;
            ans[i][14] = 1;
            ans[i][15] = 0;
            ans[i][16] = 1;
            ans[i][17] = 0;
            ans[i][18] = 1;
            ans[i][19] = 0;
            ans[i][20] = 1;
        }

        // Precompute ncr
        for (int a = 0; a < 40; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 40; b++) {
                if (b > a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 0;
                } else if (b == 0 || b == a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 1;
                } else {
                    ncr[a][b] = ncr[a - 1][b - 1] + ncr[a - 1][b];
                }
            }
        }

        // Read input
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long R = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long C = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        String str = br.readLine();

        int n = (int)(R + C);
        long[][] blockarea = new long[n][n];
        long[][] totalarea = new long[n + 1][n + 1];

        for (int a = 0; a < n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < n; b++) {
                blockarea[a][b] = ncr[a][(int)(R - 1)] * ncr[b][(int)(R - 1)];
            }
        }

        for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                totalarea[a][b] = 0;
                if (a == 0 || b == 0) continue;
                totalarea[a][b] = totalarea[a][b - 1] + totalarea[a - 1][b] - totalarea[a - 1][b - 1] + blockarea[a - 1][b - 1];
            }
        }

        long[][] revarea = new long[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                revarea[a][b] = totalarea[n][n] - totalarea[n][b] - totalarea[a][n] + totalarea[a][b];
            }
        }

        long d = Math.min(2 * n - 1, n + R - 4);

        Map<Long, Long>[][] dp = new ArrayList[n+1][n+1];
        Map<Long, Long>[][] bp = new ArrayList[n+1][n+1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
                bp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }

        // Initialize
        dp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        bp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);

        long best = ans[(int) R][(int) C];
        long m1 = (-best + totalarea[n][n]) / 2;
        long m2 = totalarea[n][n] - m1;
        long bestfreq = 0;

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                // First condition
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = new HashMap<>(dp[x][y]);
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = entry.getKey() + totalarea[n][y + 1] - totalarea[x][y + 1];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        dp[x][y + 1].put(area2, dp[x][y + 1].getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                // Second condition
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt(n - x + n - y - 2) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = new HashMap<>(bp[x][y]);
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = totalarea[n][n] - entry.getKey() - totalarea[n - x][n - (y + 1)];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        bp[x][y + 1].put(area2, bp[x][y + 1].getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (int y = 0; y <= n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[x + 1][y] - totalarea[x][y];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = new HashMap<>(dp[x][y]);
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long c = entry.getKey() + newarea;
                        long area2 = totalarea[x + 1][n] - c;
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        long newCount = dp[x + 1][y].getOrDefault(c, 0L) + entry.getValue();
                        dp[x + 1][y].put(c, newCount);
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt(n - x + n - y - 2) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[n - x][n - y] - totalarea[n - x - 1][n - y];
                    long currentCount = bp[x][y].getOrDefault(totalarea[n - x][n - y], 0L);
                    long newCount = bp[x + 1][y].getOrDefault(totalarea[n - x - 1][n - y], 0L) + currentCount;
                    bp[x + 1][y].put(totalarea[n - x - 1][n - y], newCount);
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) dp[x][y].clear();
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d) bp[x][y].clear();
            }
        }

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            int y = (int) (d - x);
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dp[x][y].entrySet()) {
                long c = entry.getKey();
                long freq = entry.getValue();
                long key1 = m1 - c;
                long key2 = m2 - c;
                // sum over bp for both m1 - c and m2 - c
                Long val1 = ((Map<Long, Long>) (Object) bp[n - x][n - y]).getOrDefault(key1, 0L);
                if (val1 != null) {
                    bestfreq += freq * val1;
                }
                if (m1 != m2) {
                    Long val2 = ((Map<Long, Long>) (Object) bp[n - x][n - y]).getOrDefault(key2, 0L);
                    if (val2 != null) {
                        bestfreq += freq * val2;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
}
